subject: Pilot evaluation: acceptance playlist, exit gates, and evidence artefacts
messages:
From: Diane Harris <diane.harris@wellcarelabs.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot evaluation — defining acceptance & evidence

Laura,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency and cost profiles. Before we commit to a pilot I need to make sure we have a concrete acceptance plan that satisfies our security and product teams. Can you share:

- A short list of success criteria (what "good" looks like for the pilot)
- Exit gates (what would cause us to pause or stop)
- Acceptance tests or sample test vectors we can run (functional, perf, and stability)
- A small evidence template we can use to capture results for procurement and legal

We have a 6-week window we can use starting July. Procurement will also need the MAP / mutual action plan so we can align milestones to contract terms.

Can you send an "acceptance playlist" (one-page) + a MAP spreadsheet? If possible please include SLA thresholds you recommend for a 30-day pilot and any fail-fast criteria.

Thanks,
Diane Harris\Director, ML Engineering\WellCare Labs

--

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 11:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot evaluation — defining acceptance & evidence

Diane —

Appreciate the clear ask. I created a short "acceptance playlist" (summary below) and attached two artifacts: MAP_v1.xlsx and an acceptance-evidence-template.docx. MAP_v1 contains milestone dates we typically use for a 6-week pilot; these are flags not hard commitments.

Acceptance playlist (one-page summary):
1) Success signals (must-haves to be green):
   - Latency: p95 generation < 450ms for 3k token sessions
   - Throughput: sustained 20 qps on reserved pool without queue growth
   - Accuracy: sample hallucination rate < 3% on curated test set (we'll share vectors)
   - Data isolation: VPC egress blocked; audit logs enabled for request/response
2) Exit gates (blockers to proceed):
   - Reproducible data leakage or egress policy failures
   - Sustained latency > 1.5s p95 for 24+ hours during normal load
   - Critical security finding (from your security review) that prevents onboarding
3) Acceptance tests (deliverables we run/observe):
   - Functional smoke: 50 curated queries covering domain scenarios (pass/fail matrix)
   - Performance sweep: ramp tests at 5, 10, 20 qps (collect latency percentiles and error rate)
   - Stability run: 72-hour soak at target throughput to flag memory growth/KV cache issues
   - Regression harness: run previous baseline prompts and compare token-level divergence metrics
4) Evidence & artifacts:
   - Filled acceptance-evidence-template.docx per test (one doc per test suite)
   - MAP_v1.xlsx for mutual milestones, owners, and signoff dates

Next steps I recommend:
- We (Laura) will run the first functional smoke test with your team the week we start.
- Jordan will propose the performance test scripts and SLA thresholds (cc'd).
- Kimberly will coordinate security evidence and signoff checklist.

If that looks good I'll upload the MAP and template now.

Cheers,
Laura Bennett\Strategic Solutions, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199

Attachments: MAP_v1.xlsx, acceptance-evidence-template.docx

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Pilot evaluation — defining acceptance & evidence

Diane / team — quick technical additions from my side. I sketched a minimal test harness and concrete pass/fail thresholds below so you have actionable checks on day 1.

Inline on Laura's playlist: 
> - Latency: p95 generation < 450ms for 3k token sessions
I'll add: measure both cold-start first token and steady-state per-token latency. Pass if first-token < 600ms and per-token add < 60ms at p95.

> - Throughput: sustained 20 qps on reserved pool without queue growth
We'll instrument queue depth and CPU/GPU utilization. Pass if queue depth < 3 and GPU util < 85% for sustained 2-hour window at target throughput.

> - Accuracy: sample hallucination rate < 3% on curated test set
We propose a short rubric: false-fact, out-of-scope, hallucination; each test vector gets a binary pass/fail plus short note. KPI = % vectors passing.

Concrete tests / owners (proposed):
- Functional smoke (owner: WellCare + Laura): 50 vectors (pass >= 90%)
- Performance sweep (owner: Jordan): produce JSON trace with latency percentiles and GPU metrics; attach CSV to evidence doc
- Stability soak (owner: Jordan): 72hr run, generate memory/kv-cache growth plots; pass if no unbounded growth and error rate < 0.5%
- Security checklist (owner: Kimberly): KMS integration confirmed, SOC2 evidence pointers in evidence doc

I attached a short test script (inline) and example CSV headers in the MAP. If useful we can run the perf sweep from our dedicated pool and provide the raw traces for you to replay.

One more ask: please confirm any regulatory retention constraints (PII retention window) so we can adjust logging.

-Jordan
Technical Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
